newsitem.title: CHINA: China plans $1.82 bln Sino-Singaporean paper mill.
newsitem.headline: China plans $1.82 bln Sino-Singaporean paper mill.

text.p: China and a Singaporean paper pulp company plan to build Asia's largest paper mill, with investment totalling 15.1 billion yuan ($1.82 billion), the Xinhua news agency said on Monday.
The plant, to be built in Zhenjiang in eastern Jiangsu province, would have annual production capacity of 1.35 million tonnes of paper, Xinhua quoted local officials as saying.
The mill was expected to realise annual sales of 8.76 billion yuan and generate 2.83 billion yuan in profits and taxes a year, the agency said.
The Chinese partner in the project would be the Zhenjiang City Light Industrial Corp, it said without elaborating.
Investors would build a 20,000-dead weight tonne multi-purpose berth, a thermal power plant and a water supply station to service the plant, Xinhua said without elaborating.
